name: Costco Kirkland Deli Fresh Atlantic Salmon Milano (Scrape Off Half Herb Butter)
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale Deli (Logan / Lehi / South Jordan / Sandy, UT)
whyItWorks: Thick, skinless Atlantic salmon fillets in Costco's take-and-bake deli case are packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids; removing half of the basil pesto butter puck keeps fat and garlic mild while baking up tender in 25 minutes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Before baking at 400°F, remove half or two-thirds of the basil-pesto butter rounds on top of the salmon (or bake the fillets with just olive oil and salt) and serve over white jasmine rice.
watchOuts: The basil pesto butter medalions contain dairy butter and garlic—use only a small slice of the butter during sensitive periods
